title: Ticket GP-24187: Kearney Workstation Update Failing

fields.requester: Ruth Sandoval – Office Administrator, Kearney Secondary Office
fields.location: Kearney Secondary Office – Continuity Room, Seat 6 of 8
fields.subject: GPCN-KRN-06 won't install March cumulative update – fails at 61%, rolls back
fields.description:
Workstation GPCN-KRN-06 in the Kearney secondary office won't install the March cumulative update. It fails at 61% with error 0x800f0922 and rolls back on every reboot. I've tried three times since 11:30.

It's one of our 8 continuity seats. Nobody is using it this afternoon, but the update window closes at 17:00 today and after that it gets flagged as out of compliance.

Can someone remote in this afternoon? I'm at my desk until 16:30.

Thanks,
Ruth Sandoval
Kearney Office
